read: The room is warming up with the sunset; I’m laying down inviting grooves, nothing too assertive, just setting a deep, soulful foundation.

tracks.title: Evan Finds the Third Room
tracks.why: Warm, funky, chill groove. Perfect for sipping drinks as the city glows.
tracks.transition: Let the bassline slowly fade, creating space for the next.

tracks.title: Sunday Hotel
tracks.why: Deep, soulful, slightly melancholic. A smooth transition into Detroit warmth.
tracks.transition: Blend the warm pads and gentle beat into the next track's intro.

tracks.title: Nespole
tracks.why: Organic, evolving, rich textures. Introduces a subtle, driving rhythm.
tracks.transition: Long blend, allowing the synth textures to intertwine with the next.

tracks.title: Rose Rouge
tracks.why: Iconic, jazzy house. Hypnotic sax riff draws people deeper into the mood.
tracks.transition: Isolate the kick and bass, then bring in the next track's rhythm.

tracks.title: Bar A Thym
tracks.why: Classic deep house, warm chords, subtle energy. Makes you want to sway.
tracks.transition: Let the deep bassline and filtered drums carry into the next track.

tracks.title: Devoted To U
tracks.why: Uplifting, soulful house with disco leanings. Solidifies feel-good groove.
tracks.transition: Let the main loop ride out, smoothly bringing in the next track.
